d: Om, a junior film artist, is smitten by Shantipriya, a renowned actress, but is killed while trying to save her from a fire accident. Thirty years later, he is reborn and sets out to avenge her death.
Khalujan and Babban, two rogues, fall in love with Krishna, their friend's widow. However, Krishna manipulates them into carrying out her bidding for her selfish gain.
Gaurav, a young man living in Miami, USA, wishes to settle down and marry his girlfriend. However, his plans are put on hold when he travels to Mumbai and is mistaken for a spy.
Top, Dhoti and Suitboot land on Kailash Parbat where they meet Nandi and Mooshak Raj. There, they come across stories about Bal Ganesh, who fights to rid the world of demons.
After his son's death, Balraj attempts to convince his daughter-in-law Malvika to marry Rajat, her childhood friend. However, his endeavours are disregarded by his wife and elder brother.
Raju and Urmila fall deeply in love and vow to reunite in India. However, complications arise when Raju agrees to pose as Sharmila's husband before her family.
Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.
Romeo, a ruffian, starts working for Shivraj, a drug lord, and they end up falling for the same girl, Chanda. Soon, a fight between the two ensues to win her over.
Sanjana is desperate to revive her hopeless relationship with Rahul. However, when the brooding and mysterious Shekhar comes along, her heart starts gravitating towards a new possibility.
Swept up in a whirlwind of fear and romance, Kiran teeters on the edge of a mental and emotional precipice. While Sunil keeps holding on to her, Rahul spares no effort to drag her down with himself.
